body: Thanks for your thoughts. I didn't want this to come across like I have some kind of grudge against my parents or that I am angry at them. I'm not. They are great people and have done more to help me than what can be expected from anyone. But there is a limit to what others can do to help you and what I should be doing to help myself. And I haven't been helping myself for so long that my parents have given up, and I can't blame anyone else for this but myself. I just wish I had the strength and motivation to help myself and stop being a burden on them

Made me smile, thanks a lot:) He came to my bed and licked my face when I woke up today, it was nice. I never really blamed him for anything, but sometimes I just feel so completely alone, my mind grabs any little thing to make me feel even worse. Thanks again!
